bestFor: 知识科普、方法论、书单/清单类长内容，观点输出
canvasNote: Tuned for 3:4. 1:1 is usable but COSTS CONTENT: the canvas loses 360px of height and padding does not shrink, so a cover normally has to drop its subtitle and an items-card will not fit its 3rd entry. Measured overflow on a normal-length deck at 1080x1080: cover 98px, resource cards 51px, items card 355px. Extreme ratios (2.35:1 banner, 9:16 full-screen) break the layout outright.
